description: Apply the exp713 soft-to-hard recipe at the bigger compute scale: fork of exp710 (1.2215 @ 116.4M, bs=48 * 16K = 393M tokens, hybrid_smooth backward). Single change: backward_mode 'hybrid_smooth' -> 'soft' (single-row argmax hard forward + K-row soft backward). Loads exp710's final checkpoint. Restarts LR schedule (10% warmup + cosine decay to 10% of peak), runs 4000 hard steps at bs=48 (98.3M tokens added on top, 25% of original compute). Tests: does the soft->hard recipe (which beat soft by 12.7 mb at the small scale in exp713) reproduce at the 393M-token regime? Reference points: exp710 (soft, 1.2215) is the target to beat; exp713 demonstrated -12.7 mb gain from this recipe at the small scale.
